After a burst flushes, subsequent edit bursts must remain able to schedule and save independently.
Pending document-buffer responsibility must remain independent of Badge retirement, including close/reopen behavior and synchronous navigation initiated by store listeners.
Existing Workspace, Preview, Store, Badge, BufferBank, and Trailing public interfaces and all unrelated observable behavior must be preserved.
Preview behavior is outside scope and must retain its independent trailing task and 40 ms quiet interval.

Badge detachment may occur during retirement, but it must not cancel BufferBank-owned pending document work.

createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.

class BufferBank
 def initialize;@entries={};end
 def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end
end
def edit(text);view=@current;@env.write(view.id,text) if view;end

class Preview
 def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end
 def query(text);@task.push(text);end
 def hide;@task.cancel;end
end

Timer expiry invokes Trailing#flush, which writes the latest pending text.
A later edit after a completed flush begins a new burst.
Store writes may synchronously invoke listeners that navigate, close, or open another view.
